title: GPTZero: Robust Detection of LLM-Generated Texts
abstract: arXiv:2602.13042v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While historical considerations surrounding text authenticity revolved primarily around plagiarism, the advent of large language models (LLMs) has introduced a new challenge: distinguishing human-authored from AI-generated text. This shift raises significant concerns, including the undermining of skill evaluations, the mass-production of low-quality content, and the proliferation of misinformation. Addressing these issues, we introduce GPTZero 5.0, a state-of-the-art industrial AI detection solution, offering reliable discernment between human and LLM-generated text. Our key contributions include: introducing a hierarchical, multi-task architecture enabling a flexible taxonomy of human and AI texts, setting a new state-of-the-art for AI detection accuracy on 11 independent third-party benchmarks and 18 writing domains, and achieving superior robustness to adversarial attacks and paraphrasing via multi-tiered automated red teaming. GP

translated_title: GPTZero：对大语言模型生成文本的鲁棒检测
translated_abstract: 虽然历史上对文本真实性的考量主要围绕抄袭展开，但大语言模型（LLM）的出现带来了新的挑战：区分人类撰写的文本与AI生成的文本。这一转变引发了重大担忧，包括对技能评估的破坏、低质量内容的大规模生产以及错误信息的泛滥。为应对这些问题，我们推出了GPTZero 5.0，一种最先进的工业级AI检测解决方案，能够在人类文本与LLM生成的文本之间实现可靠判别。我们的主要贡献包括：引入分层多任务架构，实现对人类与AI文本的灵活分类；在11个独立第三方基准和18个写作领域上确立了AI检测准确率的新技术水平；并通过多层级自动化红队测试，实现了对对抗性攻击和文本改写的卓越鲁棒性。
tldr: GPTZero 5.0通过分层多任务架构和多层自动化红队测试，在11个第三方基准和18个写作领域上实现了最先进的AI文本检测准确率，并能鲁棒地抵御对抗攻击与改写。
en_tdlr: GPTZero 5.0 achieves state-of-the-art AI text detection accuracy across 11 third-party benchmarks and 18 writing domains, with superior robustness to adversarial attacks and paraphrasing through a hierarchical multi-task architecture and multi-tiered automated red teaming.
